snippet.title: Par Under Review — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
What’s left of golf without the swing? Every decision.

In the 1930s, as numbered irons arrive, you play golf on paper: a deck of clubs, a pair of dice, and a par to get under. Read the odds, plan for the miss. A turn-based roguelike where the rules come from golf itself.

All footage captured in-game.

Wishlist on Steam.

Made by Minor Planet Games.

Music: “BugaBlue” by The U.S. Army Blues, from Live at Blues Alley
